result.summary: Found 2 minor visual issues related to inconsistent heart icon styling and missing image content in the carousel section.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a white background circle, while the heart icon on the pizza card below it has a dark/transparent background, creating inconsistent styling between similar card components.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart icon background style across all promotional/restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' card image in the 'Fastest near you' row is mostly cut off, showing only a sliver of its background image, making it hard to identify the food item.
issues.suggestion: This may be intentional as a scroll hint, but ensure enough of the image is visible to give users a clear preview before scrolling.
